originalSummary: Once environment variables are checked, you must complete steps specific to systems that have Onboard Key Manager \(OKM\), NetApp Storage Encryption \(NSE\) or NetApp Volume Encryption \(NVE\) enabled.
fixedSummary: Once environment variables are checked, you must complete steps specific to systems that have Onboard Key Manager OKM, NetApp Storage Encryption NSE or NetApp Volume Encryption NVE enabled.

originalSummary: To complete the replacement procedure and restore your system to full operation, you must recable the storage, restore the NetApp Storage Encryption configuration (if necessary), and install licenses for the new controller.
fixedSummary: To complete the replacement procedure and restore your system to full operation, you must recable the storage, restore the NetApp Storage Encryption configuration if necessary, and install licenses for the new controller.

originalSummary: You must replace a DIMM in the controller module when your system registers an increasing number of correctable error correction codes (ECC); failure to do so causes a system panic.
fixedSummary: You must replace a DIMM in the controller module when your system registers an increasing number of correctable error correction codes ECC. Failure to do so causes a system panic.

originalSummary: You replace the real-time clock (RTC) battery in the controller module so that your system's services and applications that depend on accurate time synchronization continue to function.
fixedSummary: You replace the real-time clock RTC battery in the controller module so that your system's services and applications that depend on accurate time synchronization continue to function.

originalSummary: To hot-swap a de-stage controller power module \(DCPM\), which contains the NVRAM11 battery, you must locate the failed DCPM module, remove it from the chassis, and install the replacement DCPM module.
fixedSummary: To hot-swap a de-stage controller power module DCPM, which contains the NVRAM11 battery, you must locate the failed DCPM module, remove it from the chassis, and install the replacement DCPM module.

originalSummary: The NVRAM module consists of the NVRAM11 and DIMMs and up to two NVMe SSD Flash Cache modules (Flash Cache or caching modules) per NVRAM module.
fixedSummary: The NVRAM module consists of the NVRAM11 and DIMMs and up to two NVMe SSD Flash Cache modules per NVRAM module.
